latest_release.body:
<!-- For major releases, add a tag line

- [Docs @ v1.18.0](https://github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/tree/v1.18.0/docs)
- [Examples @ v1.18.0](https://github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/tree/v1.18.0/examples)

## Installation one-liner

```shell
kubectl apply -f https://infra.tekton.dev/tekton-releases/pipeline/previous/v1.18.0/release.yaml
```

## Attestation

The Rekor UUID for this release is `108e9186e8c5677a60b5706509f09f5e185c25597018b15d790c34d2a4f4357d357cb747b9fe0109`

Obtain the attestation:
```shell
REKOR_UUID=108e9186e8c5677a60b5706509f09f5e185c25597018b15d790c34d2a4f4357d357cb747b9fe0109
rekor-cli get --uuid $REKOR_UUID --format json | jq -r .Attestation | jq .
```

Verify that all container images in the attestation are in the release file:
```shell
RELEASE_FILE=https://infra.tekton.dev/tekton-releases/pipeline/previous/v1.18.0/release.yaml
REKOR_UUID=108e9186e8c5677a60b5706509f09f5e185c25597018b15d790c34d2a4f4357d357cb747b9fe0109

# Obtains the list of images with sha from the attestation
REKOR_ATTESTATION_IMAGES=$(rekor-cli get --uuid "$REKOR_UUID" --format json | jq -r .Attestation | jq -r '.subject[]|.name + ":v1.18.0@sha256:" + .digest.sha256')

# Download the release file
curl -L "$RELEASE_FILE" > release.yaml

# For each image in the attestation, match it to the release file
for image in $REKOR_ATTESTATION_IMAGES; do
  printf $image; grep -q $image release.yaml && echo " ===> ok" || echo " ===> no match";
done
```

<!-- Any special upgrade notice
## Upgrade Notices

## Changes

# Features

* :sparkles: Add option continueAndFail on step.onError (#10536)

Step onError now supports continueAndFail, which continues executing subsequent steps but fails the TaskRun after all steps complete.

### Fixes

* :bug: release: set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH so published images get a real creation timestamp (#10860)

Published images now carry a real creation timestamp (the release commit's), instead of inheriting the base image's.

* :bug: fix: Make controller-managed labels immutable via webhook (#10687)

Controller-managed labels (tekton.dev/pipeline, tekton.dev/pipelineTask, tekton.dev/pipelineRun) are now immutable once set and cannot be changed by users updating a PipelineRun or TaskRun.

* :bug: fix: bump plumbing ko image to Go 1.27.3 (#10937)

* :bug: fix: Fix truncation of large Tekton bundles resolved from OCI images, which could cause the bundle to fail to parse. (#10395)

* :bug: fix early PVC cleanup for pipelines-in-pipelines child-pipelines (#9727)
